quote: The enthalpy of formation of t~-Bi20 3 at 298 K was determined by solution calorimetry [1892Dit, 09Mix] and more recently by combustion calorimetry [61Mah]. It also was derived from emf measurements [71Rao, 73Cha, 78Cah, 84Ito, 84Sch] and mass spectrometry data [80Sid]. These results are listed in Table 6. The values from measurements at higher temperatures are relatively scattered, but they are compatible with the low-temperature data. The mean value obtained from calorimetric data (-573.2 kJ/moi) is in good agreement with the mean value obtained from emf measurements (-570.2 kJ/mol).
